items.text: The chosen structural system for the building is a reinforced concrete (RC) building with a Special Moment Resisting Frame (SMRF). The columns and beams are carefully laid out in coordination with the architectural and services planning. This arrangement ensures that the structure can effectively support and transmit forces from earthquake motions, gravity, and live loads to the ground. The significance of this system increases as the building height increases. Hence, the key requirements for the structural systems are sufficient strength to prevent failure, adequate lateral stiffness, and efficient performance over the building's lifespan.

items.text: The selection and arrangement of major structural elements to efficiently resist gravity and horizontal loads are essential in determining the building's structural form. items.text: Due to the eccentricity arising between the center of mass and the center of rigidity at each floor level of the building, code requires increase in shear forces on the lateral force resisting elements caused by the twisting about the vertical axis of the building. Hence design codes prescribe that the actual center of mass shall be shifted by a stipulated value to consider accidental torsional force in the lateral force resisting elements, i.e. columns and shear walls. In this part of the checklist, accidental eccentricity to be considered in x-direction as per the clause 5.6 of NBC 105:2025 is to be listed. As per the clause, the value of accidental eccentricity shall be +0.05*by where by is the floor lateral dimension of the building perpendicular to the direction of lateral force EQx. Thus, the design eccentricity at floor level i, edi,y will be equal to esi,y+0.05*by where esi,y is the actual static eccentricity in y-direction.

items.text: The building was modeled using the ETABS 19.0.0 software. ETABS 19.0.0 is a specialized program designed specifically for the analysis and design of building systems. It offers a user-friendly interface and advanced features, making it both sophisticated and easy to use. The software provides intuitive modeling capabilities, powerful analytical tools, efficient design procedures, robust numerical methods, and supports various international design codes. With its ability to handle complex structures and nonlinear behaviors, ETABS 19.0.0 is widely preferred by structural engineers in the building industry. For the design of foundation, manual calculation was done.

items.text: As per Clause 3.2.1 of NBC 105:2025, the Equivalent Static Method may be used for all serviceability limit state calculations regardless of the building characteristics. For the ultimate limit state, the Equivalent Static Method may be used when at least one of the listed criteria is satisfied, including that the height of the structure is less than or equal to 15 m. The total height of the building is 9.525 m (3 stories × 3.175 m), which is less than 15 m. Therefore, the Equivalent Static Method is applicable for both ULS and SLS, and Modal Response Spectrum Analysis is not required.

items.text: One of the basic virtues of earthquake resistant design of structures is that the structure shall be regular as much as possible. It is observed that the structures with simple and regular configurations suffer much less damage during a large earthquake in comparison to the structures with irregular configurations.
